ex.en: I'll keep all the ideas we discussed for the upcoming project proposal.
ex.zh: 我會把我們討論過的所有想法留給下一個專案提案用。

ex.en: Tom has no intention of asking Mary to the upcoming dance.
ex.zh: 湯姆不打算邀瑪麗參加即將舉辦的舞會。

ex.en: Please check the schedule for upcoming events.
ex.zh: 請查看近期活動的時間表。

ex.en: Do you mind helping me carry this box upstairs?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我把這個箱子搬上樓嗎？

ex.en: My room is upstairs on the left.
ex.zh: 我的房間在樓上左邊。

ex.en: Would you carry my luggage upstairs?
ex.zh: 你可以把我的行李拿到樓上嗎?

ex.en: It seems that the burglar broke in through an upstairs window.
ex.zh: 小偷似乎是從樓上的窗戶闖進來的。

ex.en: The upstairs bathroom is being repaired.
ex.zh: 樓上的浴室正在整修。

ex.en: The smoke went upward through the chimney.
ex.zh: 煙從煙囪往上冒。

ex.en: He was looking upward to the sky.
ex.zh: 他抬頭望著天空。

ex.en: Prices continue their upward trend.
ex.zh: 價格持續上漲。

ex.en: There is upward pressure on salaries.
ex.zh: 薪資有上漲的壓力。

ex.en: Prices went up last month.
ex.zh: 上個月物價上漲了。

ex.en: Please stand up.
ex.zh: 請站起來。

ex.en: We used up all the paper.
ex.zh: 我們把紙都用完了。

ex.en: Finish up your work before you leave.
ex.zh: 離開前把工作做完。

ex.en: Are you up yet?
ex.zh: 你起床了嗎？

ex.en: I was up all night working.
ex.zh: 我熬夜工作了一整晚。

ex.en: It's up to you.
ex.zh: 由你決定。

ex.en: The hall holds up to 200 people.
ex.zh: 這個大廳最多可容納兩百人。

ex.en: His life was full of ups and downs.
ex.zh: 他的人生充滿起起落落。

ex.en: In life there are ups and downs.
ex.zh: 人生總有起起伏伏。

ex.en: The upper reaches of the river are very beautiful.
ex.zh: 這條河的上游非常美。

ex.en: The meeting room is on the upper floor.
ex.zh: 會議室在樓上。

ex.en: Put the box on the upper shelf.
ex.zh: 把箱子放在上層架子。

ex.en: The company's upper management approved the plan.
ex.zh: 公司高層核准了這項計畫。

ex.en: Upper management will make the final decision.
ex.zh: 最後由高層主管做決定。

ex.en: He thought he had the upper hand, but I turned the tables on him.
ex.zh: 他以為自己佔了上風，但我反將了他一軍。

ex.en: Our team had the upper hand in the second half.
ex.zh: 我們隊在下半場佔了上風。

upset.zh: 難過的、心煩的、不高興的

ex.en: I didn't think that Tom would be so upset.
ex.zh: 我沒想到湯姆會這麼不高興。

ex.en: When someone's upset, it's best to stay quiet.
ex.zh: 有人心情不好的時候，最好保持安靜。

ex.en: I didn't mean to upset you.
ex.zh: 我不是故意讓你難過的。

ex.en: The news upset her a lot.
ex.zh: 這個消息讓她非常難過。

ex.en: The office has been topsy-turvy since the merger upset everything.
ex.zh: 自從合併打亂了一切，辦公室就一團混亂。

ex.en: The bad weather upset our travel plans.
ex.zh: 壞天氣打亂了我們的旅遊計畫。

ex.en: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.
ex.zh: 別吃太多，免得吃壞肚子。

ex.en: I have an upset stomach today.
ex.zh: 我今天肚子不舒服。

ex.en: Her speech uplifted everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 她的演講鼓舞了在場的每個人。

ex.en: The new park has uplifted the whole neighborhood.
ex.zh: 新公園讓整個社區煥然一新。

ex.en: The company expects an uplift in sales this quarter.
ex.zh: 公司預期這一季的銷售會成長。

ex.en: The good news gave the team a much-needed uplift.
ex.zh: 這個好消息替團隊打了一劑強心針。

ex.en: A good education doesn't imply a good upbringing.
ex.zh: 受過良好的教育不代表就有良好的教養。

ex.en: She had a strict upbringing in a small village.
ex.zh: 她在一個小村莊裡受到嚴格的家教長大。

ex.en: His polite manners reflect a good upbringing.
ex.zh: 他禮貌的舉止反映出良好的家教。

ex.en: Orders showed an upturn in March after a quiet start to the year.
ex.zh: 年初較為冷清後，三月訂單開始回升。

ex.en: The company delayed hiring until the upturn in demand looked stable.
ex.zh: 公司等到需求回升趨勢穩定後才恢復招募。

ex.en: Sami uploaded the photos.
ex.zh: Sami 上傳了照片。

ex.en: Please upload the signed form before Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前上傳簽署完成的表格。

ex.en: The monthly fee covers landscaping and building upkeep.
ex.zh: 每月費用包含景觀整理和建築維護。

ex.en: Older homes often require more upkeep than buyers expect.
ex.zh: 老房子需要的維護往往比買家預期的多。

ex.en: The group booked an upscale restaurant for the award dinner.
ex.zh: 團隊為頒獎晚宴預訂了一間高級餐廳。

ex.en: The brand is moving into upscale skincare products.
ex.zh: 這個品牌正拓展高價位的護膚產品。

ex.en: You can upgrade your computer with more random access memory to make the PC faster.
ex.zh: 你可以加裝記憶體來升級電腦，讓它跑得更快。

ex.en: The airline upgraded us to business class.
ex.zh: 航空公司把我們升等到商務艙。

ex.en: With this upgrade, one obvious impact is that users will be obliged to reset their passwords.
ex.zh: 這次升級最明顯的影響，是使用者必須重設密碼。

ex.en: We got a free room upgrade because it was our honeymoon.
ex.zh: 因為我們是來度蜜月，所以免費升等房型。

ex.en: Could I get you to update this data for me?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我更新這份資料嗎？

ex.en: Windows is updating.
ex.zh: Windows 正在更新。

ex.en: My PC is in the middle of an update.
ex.zh: 我的電腦正在更新。

ex.en: Thanks for the updates.
ex.zh: 謝謝你告訴我最新進度。

ex.en: Can you give me an update on the project?
ex.zh: 可以跟我說一下專案的最新進度嗎？

update.zh: keep someone updated：隨時告知最新狀況

ex.en: Please keep me updated.
ex.zh: 請隨時告訴我最新狀況。

ex.en: I'll keep you updated on any changes.
ex.zh: 有任何變動我會隨時通知你。
